notes: Historical EBIT is mapped to 'Operating income' from Comcast's consolidated statement of income (EBIT proxy). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

Historical D&A is mapped to 'Depreciation and amortization' from the consolidated cash flow statement (cash-flow D&A add-back). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

Capex is mapped to the consolidated cash flow line 'Capital expenditures' (reported as outflow; stored here as positive absolute). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

NWC is constructed as: (Receivables, net + Other current assets) - (Accounts payable & accrued expenses related to trade creditors + Deferred revenue + Accrued expenses and other current liabilities), excluding cash and excluding the current portion of debt. This yields negative NWC levels for 2023–2025 (used as-is in DCF QA). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

Tax rate is modeled as the average effective income tax rate from 2023–2025 using income tax expense divided by income before income taxes; one-time items may distort the normalized rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

WACC is taken from a provider estimate (StockAnalysis) and treated as a base-case input; actual model WACC may differ depending on chosen capital structure and market inputs. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cmcsa/statistics/))

NOL balance uses the deferred tax asset line item 'Net operating loss and other loss carryforwards' (includes valuation allowance context); exact gross federal/state NOLs and usable timing are not provided in this line, so NOL utilization percent is a modeling placeholder. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

Comps multiples are sourced from StockAnalysis: EV / Sales and EV / EBITDA plus forward P/E. These are provider snapshots and may not be strictly 'EV/NTM Revenue' and 'EV/NTM EBITDA' by your internal definition. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/chtr/statistics/))

Base-case forecast driver magnitudes are designed to be consistent with the observed 2023–2025 run-rate and conservative mean reversion (not promotional). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

catalysts: Broadband go-to-market shift execution and resulting stabilization of connectivity revenue trends (management referenced early encouraging results). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))
Theme parks contribution ramp as Epic Universe attendance and per-cap spending mature. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Wireless convergence progress (record wireless net adds in 2025) translating into better customer mix and lower churn economics. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Post-Versant structural reset may improve investor visibility into a more focused NBCUniversal earnings profile. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))
company_overview: Comcast is a global media and technology company operating Connectivity & Platforms and Content & Experiences businesses. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Connectivity & Platforms includes broadband, wireless, and business services; in 2025, management highlighted record wireless results and a new broadband go-to-market shift. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Content & Experiences includes NBCUniversal centered on streaming, live sports, and premium content, plus studios and theme parks; Epic Universe ramped following its May 2025 opening. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Comcast completed the spin of Versant Media on January 2, 2026, creating a more focused NBCUniversal. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))
current_context: Full-year 2025 revenue was $123.707B (flat YoY) and free cash flow was $19.235B (+53.4% YoY). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Management reported record wireless momentum: 1.5M net line additions and more than 9M total lines in 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

Epic Universe drove improved theme-park performance, including theme parks Adjusted EBITDA surpassing $1.0B in the quarter (per release highlights). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))

The company emphasized disciplined capital allocation while investing behind its 2026 execution priorities (per Q4 2025 press release). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026003964/ex991-12312025.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is modeled as low-single-digit, consistent with near-flat consolidated revenue recently while assuming gradual normalization beyond 2025-specific items. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

EBIT margin mean reversion is reflected via a steady improvement path to ~17.8% by 2030, aligning the model with recent operating income levels (EBIT = operating income). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

Non-cash add-back and reinvestment intensity are kept within a reasonable band using historical D&A and capex as % of sales, with D&A elevated vs 2023–24 given 2025 impacts. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))

Working capital is modeled as persistently negative (provider-style DCF convention using a level-based NWC build from balance-sheet components), supporting cash generation in the model. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1166691/000162828026004994/cmcsa-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Residential broadband competitive pressure could delay revenue growth and slow the EBIT margin recovery assumed in the base case.
Content/programming and streaming economics (including sports rights and amortization) may drive higher-than-modeled operating cost intensity.
Capex requirements and network upgrade timing could be structurally higher, pressuring FCF relative to the modeled capex % of sales band.
Working capital dynamics (currently modeled as negative) could normalize faster than expected, reducing cash generation.

valuation_summary: DCF terminal value is anchored to an economically sensible exit EV/EBITDA multiple (peers in telecom/cable/media range) combined with terminal growth via a Gordon/exit-style 'average' terminal method. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/chtr/statistics/))

Peer comparables from StockAnalysis show EV/EBITDA and forward P/E dispersion across cable/telecom/media holdings, providing cross-checks on the terminal exit multiple used in the base case. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/chtr/statistics/))

WACC used in the base case is taken from the provider estimate (StockAnalysis) and held constant across scenarios unless explicitly overridden. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cmcsa/statistics/))
